page_title: ATM 1-0 ALA | Atletico Madrid v Alaves 18/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+5' What a chance that is! Lucas Boye (Alaves) displays good awareness near the penalty spot to get on the end of a cross from the free kick, but he steers his header narrowly over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
90+4' The resulting corner from Carlos Vicente (Alaves) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
90+3' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. Alaves have a corner.
90+2' The corner kick picks out Lucas Boye (Alaves) free in the box, but his header from close in lacks control and balloons high over the bar.
90+2' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) will take the corner.
90+1' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) has a crack at goal from inside the box, but the defender somehow makes the block to deny him.
90+1' Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
90' Jon Pacheco (Alaves) makes a good run into the box and unleashes a powerful header in the centre of the box from the corner, but it rises well over the bar.
89' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Alaves.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alexander Sorloth departs the field of play to be replaced by Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid).
84' Marc Pubill (Atl. Madrid) tries to hit a shot towards goal from long range, but he miskicks the ball and it flies high over the crossbar.
82' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
81' The attendance is 61192.
81' Eduardo Coudet has decided to substitute Antonio Blanco and he is replaced by Aitor Manas (Alaves).
79' An attempted cross from Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) is cleared.
78' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) comes onto the pitch so that Johnny Cardoso can be given a rest.

76' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. The ball goes behind for a corner. Alaves will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
76' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger. The referee signals a corner kick to Alaves.
73' Good movement by Carlos Vicente (Alaves), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
70' Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) expertly controls a neat clever pass on the edge of the penalty area, but his effort smashes against the right post! What a shot that was!
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Abderrahmane Rebbach (Alaves) will replace Carles Alena.
68' A short pass finds Ander Guevara (Alaves). He spots the keeper off his line and shoots from mid-range, but the ball sails high over the bar.
67' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) latches onto a cross inside the box but fires a poor effort well wide of the right post.
62' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Alex Baena (Atl. Madrid) replaces Thiago Almada.
62' Substitution. Koke (Atl. Madrid) replaces Giuliano Simeone.
62' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) as he is replaced by Antoine Griezmann.
60' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Antonio Sivera is alert and denies him.
57' The resulting corner from Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is cleared by the defence.
57' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid win a corner kick.

57' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal. Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
55' Substitution. Toni Martinez did his best and is replaced by Lucas Boye (Alaves).
55' Here is a change. Pablo Ibanez is going off and Eduardo Coudet gives the last tactical orders to Ander Guevara (Alaves).
54' A substitution has been made. Jon Guridi is replaced by Denis Suarez (Alaves).
53' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

53' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. The referee blows his whistle, Atl. Madrid are awarded a corner kick.

48' 1 - 0 It's a goal – 1:0! Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) leaps near the penalty spot to connect with a brilliant cross from Pablo Barrios and plants a header in off the bottom of the right post. Antonio Sivera was helpless. What an excellent finish!
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+3' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atl. Madrid comes to nothing.

45+3' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the middle of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance.
45+2' Jon Guridi (Alaves) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post.
45+1' The ball is cleared after Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Carlos Vicente (Alaves) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
43' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
43' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The linesman makes the right call and Atl. Madrid will have a corner.
43' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the left post only for Antonio Sivera to dive and make a save.

42' Nahuel Tenaglia (Alaves) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Guillermo Cuadra has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. A free kick has been awarded to Atl. Madrid.
41' The free kick is taken by Carlos Vicente (Alaves), but ball is cleared.
40' The referee blows his whistle as Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) was too aggressive in his challenge.
38' Atl. Madrid take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

38' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atl. Madrid.
37' Antonio Sivera displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
36' Wonderful movement by Atl. Madrid. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
32' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) missed a promising opportunity! He rises for a cross and unleashes a poor header from near the penalty spot. The ball flies well wide of the right post!
30' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
27' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Johnny Cardoso (Atl. Madrid) was quite harsh and Guillermo Cuadra didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
24' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Alexander Sorloth, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
23' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) gets into a great position in the box after a pass, but sends his shot just wide of the left post.
20' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
17' Thiago Almada (Atl. Madrid) is flagged for offside.

15' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot low towards the middle of the goal, but Antonio Sivera pulls off a comfortable save.
15' Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
13' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) dances his way past two defending players and gets to the edge of the box from where he unleashes a shot that goes well wide of the left post.
10' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) meets a cross from the flank and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies totally wide of the left post.
6' Pablo Ibanez (Alaves) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
6' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Carlos Vicente (Alaves), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

6' Toni Martinez (Alaves) takes a brilliant touch after he latches on to a pass on the edge of the box and strikes the ball to the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper dives low and saves his attempt. Alaves force their opponents to concede a corner.
4' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
2' Guillermo Cuadra blows the whistle, Matteo Ruggeri (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for a foul.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Alaves will kick the game off.
Guillermo Cuadra got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
